## Panels & Moderation

- **SAUL Copyright Seminar 2022** (SMU) — Moderator, *https://ink.library.smu.edu.sg/saulcopyright2022/Program/Recordings_slides/3/*, exploring the implications of Singapore's text-and-data-mining copyright exception for academics and librarians.
